description: This file defines a React hook `useNotesFlow` that manages the state and operations related to notes in a frontend application. It includes functions for fetching, creating, updating, and deleting notes via an API client, along with state management and memoization logic. It also contains utility functions and type definitions for notes.

methods.name: resolveBaseUrl()
methods.description: Resolves the backend API base URL, defaulting to 'http://localhost:3001' if not set in the environment variable.

methods.name: normalizeNote(raw)
methods.description: Converts raw note data from backend into the UI note shape, applying default values where necessary.

methods.name: useNotesFlow()
methods.description: Main React hook that manages the notes collection, current selection, loading/saving states, and provides methods for note CRUD operations.
